skijump.coach.alpha_high: Angle of attack too high, risk of stall - lean forward (W or mouse down).
skijump.coach.alpha_low: You fly too flat (angle of attack too low) - lean back (S or mouse up) until the line is in the green zone.
skijump.coach.early: Takeoff %1$s ms too early - wait until the marker reaches the centre.
skijump.coach.headwind: A headwind helps - use it by keeping your angle of attack in the green zone.
skijump.coach.late: Takeoff %1$s ms too late - press Space a little earlier.
skijump.coach.no_takeoff: You did not take off at the edge - press SPACE when the marker enters the green window.
skijump.coach.roll: Too much sideways roll - correct with A/D so the marker returns to the centre.
skijump.coach.tailwind: A tailwind made the flight harder - hold your angle of attack firmly and use V.
skijump.coach.telemark_early: Telemark too early - wait for the TELEMARK NOW prompt.
skijump.coach.telemark_late: Telemark too late - press R a bit earlier.
skijump.coach.telemark_none: You forgot the telemark - press R about 0.3 s before touching the slope.
skijump.coach.v: Use V-style (key V) right after takeoff - it gives more lift and style points.

skijump.comp.your_turn_hint: Your turn! Sit on the start gate (right-click) - coordinates: %1$s %2$s %3$s
skijump.guide.1.text: You ride in the tuck position - it is automatic. A longer inrun (higher gate) and better gear mean more speed at the edge. Soon we will reach the edge, where you must take off.
skijump.guide.1.title: 1/4 Inrun
skijump.guide.2.text: Time is stopped. At the bottom you see the timing bar: the white marker approaches the green window. After resuming, press SPACE exactly when the marker enters the green window (or click the left mouse button). Too early = low, flat jump; too late = high and short.
skijump.guide.2.title: 2/4 TAKEOFF - the key moment
skijump.guide.3.text: Angle gauge on the left: keep the line in the GREEN zone (W/S or mouse). Too low = little lift, too high (red) = stall. A/D = roll (keep the marker near the centre of the bottom bar), V = V-style skis (more lift and style points).
skijump.guide.3.title: 3/4 FLIGHT - balance
skijump.guide.4.text: You are approaching the slope. Press R (telemark) about 0.3 s before touchdown - the HUD will show TELEMARK NOW. Too early or too late lowers marks, and no telemark risks a crash.
skijump.guide.4.title: 4/4 LANDING - telemark
skijump.guide.mode.1: Guide: on for every training jump.

skijump.tutorial.1: 1) Gear: in creative use the 'Ski Jump' tab; in survival craft skis, suit and helmet (stats are in the item tooltip). Wear them like armor.
skijump.tutorial.2: 2) Hill: craft a Hill Blueprint (paper + blue dye + snow block). Click a block with it - in survival you can build small and medium hills (K up to 90) for snow, stone bricks and ice; Shift + right-click changes the hill. Register your own hill with the Wand; in creative: /skijump place zakopane.
skijump.tutorial.3: 3) Start: climb to the top of the inrun and right-click the START GATE. Then SPACE = go. The tuck position is automatic.
skijump.tutorial.4: 4) TAKEOFF (most important!): a timing bar shows before the edge. Press SPACE a second time when the white marker enters the green window. Without it the jump ends after ~50 m!
skijump.tutorial.5: 5) FLIGHT: W/S or mouse = pitch (keep the angle gauge on the left in the green zone), A/D = roll, V = V-style skis (more lift and style points).
skijump.tutorial.6: 6) LANDING: press R (telemark) about 0.3 s before touching the slope - the HUD shows height and prompts the moment. Without telemark you lose marks and may crash.
skijump.tutorial.7: 7) Competition: sneak + right-click the COMPETITION STATION to open registration; Skoczek NPCs join. A 'Skoczek' spawn egg near a hill trains by itself.
skijump.tutorial.8: 8) Useful: /skijump guide on|off (guided jump), /skijump rank, /skijump top, /skijump rivals, /skijump season, /skijump abort or X. Keys R and V can be changed in Controls.
skijump.tutorial.9: 9) Survival: find natural hills with /locate structure skijump_hill (or /skijump locate). A coach's barrel with starter gear stands next to the gate. Jumps are tiring (food!) and each rank-up gives a reward.
